suggestions.roleTitleVi: Chuyên viên Phân tích Kinh doanh & Dữ liệu (BA/BI)
suggestions.reasoning: Stanford HAI (2024) indicates that business analysts utilizing AI agents complete market modeling 43% faster with 25% higher forecast accuracy. Furthermore, WEF Future of Jobs (2023) ranks Business Intelligence and Data Analysts as #3 fastest growing occupation globally. Given Trần Mai Chi's background from NEU, solid English skills, and strong business logic, she is exceptionally positioned to leverage AI automation while retaining critical human strengths like executive stakeholder alignment and strategic problem framing.
suggestions.whyItFitsYou: Your solid foundation in Business Administration from NEU combined with IELTS 7.0 and logical business thinking provides an ideal launchpad for the BA/BI track. While you currently lack deep technical hands-on experience and a concrete portfolio, your high willingness to learn and energetic work style mean you can quickly master AI-augmented tools for SQL and dashboarding, turning potential gaps into growth opportunities.

To review, validate results, and frame strategic business questions
To manually write every line of code from scratch
